version.promotionalText: Photograph exposed skewer ends. Review the automatic reference area and every marker, correct the count, then save a local record. One purchase, no subscriptions.
version.description:
Count Stick helps you count the visible ends of a skewer bundle from a photo. Take a picture or choose one from Photos, review the suggested markers, and correct the total before using it.

A reference area for your review
The app automatically estimates an area around detected stick ends when it can. The outline is a guide: missed ends can lie inside or outside it. Check the whole photo. If no area is determined, you can still review and edit the markers.

Check, correct, and keep
• See the photo, markers, and current count together.
• Enlarge the photo to inspect individual ends.
• Add missing markers or remove extra ones anywhere in the photo, with Undo for corrections.
• Save a checked result with an optional note in local history.
• Reopen or delete saved records and share a marked result image when you choose.

On-device processing
Counting and reference-area estimation run on your device. Photos are not uploaded to a server for processing. No account is required. Saved records stay on the same device and are not synced between devices.

One purchase
The paid download includes the app’s features. No in-app purchases, subscriptions, or ads.

For a clearer photo, aim at the exposed ends of the bundle, use even lighting, and keep the image in focus. Automatic results are estimates and can contain missed or extra markers. Verify every visible end before using a total for a bill or stock record. Count Stick assists manual checking; it does not calculate or collect payments.

Support: https://www.xmaillc.com/count-stick-support.html
Privacy policy: https://www.xmaillc.com/count-stick-privacy.html

version.description:
Count Stick 帮你清点照片中一束签子的可见端头。对准签头拍照，或选择相册图片，查看自动标记，核对并修正后再使用数量。

自动参考范围，方便逐点核对
App 会尝试围绕检测到的签头自动估计参考范围。虚线仅供核对参考，范围内外都可能有漏掉的签头，请检查整张照片。未能确定范围时，仍可查看和修正标记。

拍照、校对、留存
• 照片、标记和当前数量同时查看。
• 放大照片，仔细检查每个可见端头。
• 可在整张照片上补加漏标、删除误标，操作失误可撤销。
• 确认结果后添加可选备注，手动保存到本地历史记录。
• 重新查看或删除记录，按需分享带标记的结果图。

在设备上处理
计数和参考范围估计均在设备上完成，照片不会上传到服务器处理。无需注册账号。记录保存在当前设备，不跨设备同步。

一次购买
付费下载包含应用内的功能，无内购、无订阅、无广告。

拍摄时请对准签束露出的端头，保持光线均匀和画面清晰。自动结果属于估算，可能出现漏标或误标。用于结账或库存记录前，请逐个核对所有可见签头。Count Stick 是辅助核对工具，不计算金额或收款。

支持与反馈：https://www.xmaillc.com/count-stick-support.html
隐私政策：https://www.xmaillc.com/count-stick-privacy.html

reviewNotesDraft:
No account sign-in is required. Photograph the exposed ends of a skewer bundle using Camera, or choose an image from Photos. Counting runs on-device. The app estimates a reference area around detections when possible; its outline is only a guide, and the UI asks users to check for missed stick ends outside it as well. If an area cannot be determined, marker review remains available.

Use Enlarge & edit to inspect the photo. Add missing markers or remove extra ones anywhere in the image, including outside the reference area. Undo reverses an edit. Save a checked result with an optional note, reopen it from History, and use Share to export a marked result image. Saved records can be deleted.

This is a paid-upfront app with no in-app purchases, subscriptions, advertising, or remote photo-processing service. Camera permission is requested only for taking a photo. Photo counting and text-region analysis run locally; recognized text is not stored or transmitted. There is no payment calculation or collection feature.

Automatic results are estimates and may miss or add markers. Manual verification is part of the intended workflow; no guaranteed counting accuracy is claimed.
